sources.title: Reducing Solid-State Drive Read Latency by Optimizing Read-Retry
sources.read_depth: Reread original HTML sections2.2,3.2.2,4,5.1,5.2.1-5.2.3,6.1; searched availability and SET FEATURE. Not a new complete-full-paper read.
sources.evidence: Original-chip timing control via SET FEATURE on FPGA custom controller;160 real48-layer TLC chips;120 randomly selected blocks/chip; all pages tested. Defaults tPRE24us,tEVAL5us,tDISCH10us. Analysis measures RBER at final-retry-step Vref and varies wear,retention,temperature. Reported statistics are maximum/average across tested pages. Temperature safety margin is explicit.
sources.public_location_latency_data: No downloadable chip/block/WL/page-keyed timing/RBER table or author code link found in this bounded search. This is not proof that authors never release it.
sources.applicability: Demonstrates that some commodity NAND implements timing adjustment without changing chip hardware. Does not prove AiF exposes the feature, give AiF-safe single-sense timing, or expose per-location speed bins.

sources.title: AiF: Accelerating On-Device LLM Inference Using In-Flash Processing
sources.read_depth: Local original extracted paper/aif.txt sections4.2.2 and4.3 reread, lines535-550,709-724; existing architecture audit retained.
sources.evidence: Conventional single-sensing read28us measured from an actual product is used to validate circuit modeling. Be-enc changes conventional(2,3,2) to LSB-prioritized(1,3,3), and IFP weights use fastest LSB pages.
sources.public_location_latency_data: No physical-location timing table or raw per-WL safe-tR sweep is disclosed in the inspected sections/artifacts.
sources.applicability: Between-page-type advantage already consumed by LSB-only placement. Paper does not establish fixed equal tR for every real WL as a universal fact; its modeled28us is one service value. No positive per-WL heterogeneity magnitude can be inferred.

sources.title: QCFlash: Bulk Bitwise Processing in3D NAND with Dynamic Sensing and Quad-level Encoding—Artifact
sources.read_depth: Official author Zenodo metadata and complete archive file inventory/preview; archive not downloaded or executed in this bounded round.
sources.evidence: Open14.2MB artifact includes measured Vth/shared-page data from Micron96-layer QLC MT29F2T08GELBEJ4;data filenames vth_states_wl10.xlsx,wl11.xlsx,wl12.xlsx. Native decoding/bitwise/Vref-offset/RBER functions,MITcode+CCBY4data.
sources.public_location_latency_data: Accessible real physical-WL voltage/bit data, but disclosed artifact is not a tR/sensing-time sweep or ready/busy latency trace.
sources.applicability: Cannot map static Vth values into safe tR, ECC latency or retries without calibrated sensing dynamics, ECC and operating conditions. Not an AiF/LSB GEMV latency dataset.

sources.title: DLV: Exploiting Device Level Latency Variations for Performance Improvement on Flash Memory Storage Systems
sources.read_depth: Downloaded public author PDF; searched/examined model/tableI context, strong-block/RRS policy, evaluation methodology, and referenced public dataset19. Not a complete line-by-line paper read.
sources.evidence: Combines process-variation/retention-age-aware fast-block allocation and scheduling. TableI speed/reliability cases are from Monte Carlo threshold-distribution/device modeling trained with referenced datasets; evaluation uses SSDsim. Reference19 is Sun/Grayson/Wood2011 SNAPI reliability paper.
sources.public_location_latency_data: No location-keyed empirical tR/safe-timing table or public code link located in inspected text.
sources.applicability: Strong prior against generic hot-to-fast/process/retention mapping; simulated/model-derived latency is not original location-latency calibration.

sources.title: NANDFlashSim: official framework/documentation
sources.read_depth: Official overview/configuration/source-code pages and public repository landing page; no code execution or entire-repository audit.
sources.evidence: Models different physical page offsets and advanced command chains; timings co-validated with hardware prototype. Official configuration provides typical/worst-case device.ini samples for Micron MT29F8G08MAAWC andMT29F16G08QASWC.
sources.public_location_latency_data: Official pages expose a configurable simulator/sample timings, not a raw location-identified measured latency/reliability dataset.
sources.applicability: Useful public simulator; cannot label hand-configured same-LSB location variation as measured data.

sources.title: MQSim: official FAST2018 simulator
sources.read_depth: Official README NAND parameter list; original paper metadata/intro inspected in this round. No new full-source or full-paper read.
sources.evidence: Public input parameters Page_Read_Latency_LSB/CSB/MSB specify page-type service values. End-to-end SSD validation is distinct from raw physical-location timing characterization.
sources.public_location_latency_data: No chip/block/WL-indexed raw single-sense latency/safe-timing dataset supplied by inspected README.
sources.applicability: Supports categorical page-type modeling, not measured within-LSB variation. FLIN is a fairness/scheduling lead, not established here as a location-latency dataset.

sources.title: Improving NAND flash performance with read heat separation
sources.read_depth: Official IBM abstract/page reread; author PDF link identified but tool retrieval timed out this round. Existing earlier repository reliability audit retained; no new fulltext claim.
sources.evidence: Read-heat-aware low-latency-page placement and enterprise controller implementation are explicit prior.
sources.public_location_latency_data: No original location-latency table download verified in bounded search.
sources.applicability: Strong fast-first/hot-cold comparison if real heterogeneous-page data is later available.
